verses.text: If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,
lines: If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side,

verses.text: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us;
lines: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side,
when men rose up against us;

verses.text: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;
lines: then they would have swallowed us up alive,
when their wrath was kindled against us;

verses.text: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul;
lines: then the waters would have overwhelmed us,
the stream would have gone over our soul;

verses.text: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
lines: then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

verses.text: Blessed be Yahweh, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
lines: who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

verses.text: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.
lines: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare.
The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

verses.text: Our help is in Yahweh’s name, who made heaven and earth.
lines: Our help is in Yahweh’s name,
